scene: Beneath the hatch, a cavernous transit depot buzzes with waiting departures.
picture: Side view inside a subterranean transit cavern with three open exit bays. Far left, a frosted sleigh tram sits ready. Left of centre, the boy with his orange vest, white scarf, and strapped kite walks right. Centre, a tethered hot-air balloon sways gently. Far right, an empty twin chairlift waits at an iron dock.
shown: a frosty glass sleigh tram idling with its doors open on the far left
a striped hot-air balloon moored to an iron post in the centre
a swinging wooden hillside chairlift hanging from a steel cable on the far right
